newsitem.title: USA: Guilford Pharmaceuticals Q3 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Guilford Pharmaceuticals Q3 profit vs loss.

text.p: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended

(a) After giving effect to the three-for-two stock split announced October 15, 1996 to be distributed on November 12, 1996 in the form of a stock dividend to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 28, 1996, earnings (loss) per share for the quarters ended September 30, 1996 and 1995 will be $.86 and $(.43), respectively. Earnings (loss) per share for the nine month periods ended September 30, 1996 and 1995 will be $.81 and $(1.32), respectively.
Full company name is Guilford Pharmaceuticals Inc

NOTE - Q3 1996 includes a $20 million payment from Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc, the company's partner in the commercialization of the Gliadel wafer, which is for use as an adjunct to surgery to prolong survival in patients with recurrent glioblastoma multiforme.
